path_ids = set()
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('w', 'g') and n['pixels'] <= 6:
        path_ids.add(n['id'])

print("\nPath-to-left-wall adjacency:")
for a in seg['adjacency_list']:
    i, j = a
    if i in path_ids or j in path_ids:
        ni = next((n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['id'] == i), None)
        nj = next((n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['id'] == j), None)
        if ni and nj and nj['color'] == 'G':  # Dark gray wall blocks
            print(f"  {i}({ni['color']}) - {j}({nj['color']})")
